name: Mercedes-Benz
overview: The gold standard of luxury, safety, and performance in Australia, distinguished by historic local CKD assembly in Port Melbourne and world-leading AMG performance sales.
australian_history: Mercedes-Benz cars arrived in Australia in the early 20th century, but formal operations surged in 1958 when Mercedes-Benz (Australia) Pty Ltd was formed in partnership with Standard-Vacuum and Australian Motor Industries (AMI). From 1959 to 1965, Mercedes-Benz passenger cars—specifically the W120/W121 'Ponton' 190 and W110/W111 'Fintail' 220 and 220S—were assembled at AMI's factory in Port Melbourne, Victoria. Australia was one of the very few countries outside Germany to assemble Mercedes-Benz passenger cars. Local assembly concluded in 1965 as Daimler-Benz AG assumed full control of imports and distribution, establishing its headquarters in Mulgrave, Victoria. Mercedes-Benz pioneered automotive safety introductions in Australia, including crumple zones, anti-lock brakes (ABS in 1978), and electronic stability control (ESP). Australia also boasts one of the highest per-capita sales of Mercedes-AMG performance vehicles anywhere in the world, with models like the C63 AMG attaining legendary status.

models_catalog.name: C-Class
models_catalog.overview: Mercedes-Benz's top-selling luxury model line in Australia across W202, W203, W204, W205, and W206, celebrated for safety, comfort, and thundering AMG V8 variants.

generations.summary: Replaced the 190E (W201); Classic, Elegance, Sport trims, C180 to C280, and C36/C43 AMG V8.
Distinctive twin-oval headlamps, C180K, C200K, C320, C32 AMG supercharged V6, and C55 AMG 5.4L V8.
Agility Control, C200 CGI, C250, C300, and iconic naturally aspirated 6.2L M156 V8 C63 AMG.
MRA platform lightweight body, C200, C300, twin-turbo V6 C43, and 375kW 4.0L Biturbo V8 C63 S.
S-Class inspired interior with 11.9-inch portrait screen, mild-hybrid C200/C300, and 500kW C63 S E Performance.

models_catalog.name: E-Class
models_catalog.overview: The heartbeat of Mercedes-Benz in Australia. From the virtually indestructible W114/W115 and W123 that conquered outback roads and taxi fleets, through the peerless Bruno Sacco W124, to supercharged V8 E55 AMG and twin-turbo 450kW E63 S AMG monsters.

generations.summary: Legendary engineered-like-no-other-car-in-the-world durability. Highlights included 230E petrol, 280E twin-cam inline-six, and the bombproof OM617 5-cylinder 300D diesel.

Masterpiece designed by Bruno Sacco featuring innovative 5-link independent rear suspension, aerodynamic drag Cd of 0.29, 300E/320E inline-sixes, and the legendary hand-built 500E (engineered and assembled in partnership with Porsche).
Elegant aerodynamic redesign featuring Airmatic DC suspension. Highlighted by the fearsome E55 AMG (350kW supercharged 5.4L V8) and later the naturally aspirated 6.2L V8 E63 AMG.

generations.generation_name: E-Class W213 Series & E63 S AMG
generations.summary: Built on the MRA lightweight modular platform. Featured dual 12.3-inch widescreen cockpit displays, Drive Pilot semi-autonomous driving, and the almighty AMG E63 S 4MATIC+ with 450kW, 850Nm, and pure rear-wheel-drive Drift Mode.

models_catalog.name: S-Class
models_catalog.overview: The undisputed flagship of automotive innovation in Australia, introducing world-first safety and luxury technologies on W116, W126, W140, W220, W221, W222, and W223.

generations.summary: W116 introduced ABS and 450SEL 6.9; Bruno Sacco's timeless W126 with airbags and 560SEL V8.
Double-glazed W140 'Cathedral'; Airmatic W220; Night View Assist and bi-turbo V8/V12 W221.
Magic Body Control, rear-axle steering, Level 3 Drive Pilot, and ultra-luxurious Mercedes-Maybach.

models_catalog.name: G-Class (Geländewagen)
models_catalog.segment: Heavy Duty 4WD / Upper Large Luxury SUV
models_catalog.overview: The immortal Mercedes-Benz Geländewagen. Originating as a relentless military off-roader with three locking differentials, the G-Class became a trusted explorer in the Australian outback and was selected by the Australian Defence Force under Project Overlander Land 121, resulting in over 2,000 bespoke Australian Army 4x4 and 6x6 vehicles. Concurrently, the civilian W463 morphed into the ultimate status symbol through the roaring twin-turbo V8 AMG G63.

generations.summary: The pure original Geländewagen. Ladder chassis, live axles front and rear, part-time 4WD, mechanical differential locks, and bulletproof M110 petrol and OM617 diesel engines.

Heavy-duty commercial and military chassis chosen by the Australian Defence Force under Project Overlander Land 121. Over 2,000 units delivered to the Australian Army in 4x4 and bespoke 6x6 cab-chassis and ambulance configurations, powered by the OM642 3.0L turbo-diesel V6 (135kW 400Nm) with portal axles on 6x6 and dual snorkels. Civilian G300 CDI Professional sold from 2016-2019.

Transformed the G-Wagen from military workhorse into ultra-luxury automotive royalty. Featured permanent all-wheel drive with triple electro-pneumatic differential locks, G500 V8, G350 BlueTEC diesel, and the iconic supercharged G55 and twin-turbo G63 AMG.

Completely redesigned from the ground up: 121mm wider body, independent double-wishbone front suspension, electromechanical rack-and-pinion steering, Widescreen Cockpit, and the 430kW 4.0L BiTurbo AMG G63.
